title: The Blood Moon
subtitle: Surge and containment
text: A Blood Moon is a fungal surge: the Entity presses hard enough into the world to redden the lunar face, strengthen hemomancy, and stir fungal life. The pale resistance felt during the same night is not its cause. It is Our Lady's containment response, holding the larger incursion back at cost to herself. The Rite of Lethean Tide strengthens that response until the surge is forced away.
